title: Frappe ERPNext 7.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in endpoints that…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 7.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contain an SQL injection vulnerability in certain endpoints. The flaw arises because these endpoints construct part of a database query using user-supplied sort parameters without proper validation. Authenticated users with low privileges can exploit this by sending crafted requests that inject SQL code, potentially extracting sensitive information from the database.
